note: Machine rendering r2 of the six project-authored Extraversion rubric items, made for the 2026-10-06 extension of the supplementary round. Not checked by a person, not back-translated by a person, not a validated instrument.
instruction: Translate the following English text into Simplified Chinese. Output only the translation, with no explanation.
decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens 96, one field per request
